post_title: Samsung Group: 1TB Data Breach from Ransomware Attack
description:
Right now, our team is reviewing your security team’s report on defenses against ransomware attacks. However, it appears you haven’t adequately protected yourselves. We gained access through the initial entry point and spent two days inside, where we obtained ESX administrator privileges. After some time, you took the ESX device offline, and we thought we’d been detected. But when we checked again the next day, it seemed you hadn’t realized you’d been attacked—our access credentials hadn’t been changed, and you’d even brought the ESX device back online. We then continued our attack on your domain controllers: samsung-cps, samsung-rtm, and samsung-brn. What really surprised us was that all your passwords were set to “Samsung01!” We then began downloading 1 TB of data. Over the weekend, we encrypted your systems. A few hours after we confirmed that most of the data had been encrypted, your security team finally detected the breach, took all machines offline, and changed all access credentials. What struck us was that we remained undetected for over a month, yet your security team only reacted so quickly once the encryption had already taken place. Your security team failed to adequately protect your company against this ransomware attack. The the following countries: the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, Germany, Poland, India, the United Kingdom, and France. 
Samsung Group (Korean: 삼성그룹／삼성그룹, Romanization: Samseong Geurup; English: Samsung Group) is a multinational conglomerate headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, with business operations spanning a wide range of sectors including electronics, finance, insurance, biopharmaceuticals, construction, chemicals, and healthcare. Its subsidiaries include Samsung Electronics, Samsung Display, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, Samsung C&T, Samsung Heavy Industries, and Samsung Life Insurance, among others; at least three of these subsidiaries have been ranked among the Fortune Global 500 by *Fortune* magazine.

post_title: Data Breach at O&M University in the Dominican Republic
description:
O&M University of the Dominican Republic (udoym.edu.do) is an institution of higher education in the Dominican Republic founded in 1966. The following is an overview of key information from the website:

Campus Locations (Recintos)

The university has multiple campuses and colleges throughout the Dominican Republic, including:
• Main Campus: Sede Central (located at 200 Avenida de la Independencia, Santo Domingo)
• School of Medicine: Escuela de Medicina O&MED
• Branch Campuses: East Santo Domingo, West Santo Domingo, Santiago, La Romana, Puerto Plata, Moca, San José de Ocoa

Academic Programs (Oferta Académica)

• Undergraduate (Grado): Covers Business Administration, Tourism and Hospitality Management, Architecture, Education, Social Communication, Accounting, Sports and Recreation, Law, Agricultural Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Systems and Computational Engineering, Medicine, Marketing, and Psychology (Clinical, School, and Industrial tracks), among others.
• Technical Programs (Técnico): Advanced Technician in Agriculture (specializing in Crop Production).
• Graduate Programs (Postgrado): Includes a Ph.D. in the Application of Artificial Intelligence to Business Productivity, as well as master’s and specialized programs in Accounting, Mathematics Education, Music Education, Educational Administration, Systems Engineering, Educational Technology, and Software Engineering.

queenslibrary.org Queens Public Library, founded 1896, is a nonprofit serving the most diverse county from 66 locations with 5 million items in 50 languages.
It grew from an 1858 Flushing library and 1896 Long Island charter, merging seven on a 240,000 dollar Carnegie grant from 1901; four survive.CEO Walcott, a schools chancellor, runs 1,400 staff and an unpaid board; FY2026 saw 11.5 million circulations and 6.3 million visits.95 percent of funding is public: 149.9 million for FY2026, 154.1 million for FY2027, and 183.3 million in assets tied to city buildings.A 2014 scandal, when CEO Galante was fired for 670,000 in charges and a rooftop deck while cutting hours, brought city audits and FBI probes.Since 2016 projects like the 41.5 million Hunters Point and 39 million Far Rockaway libraries rebuilt it; 37 projects and 252.5 million unfunded.
